notes: The page shows an Interest Form Closed button even though it says the form opens Oct 12, so check the page for the current status. Commuter program, so you live at home.
name: BioMed Focus (Michigan Medicine summer research)
what_you_do: Work full time in a Michigan Medicine lab. You do your own research project with a mentor. You also take a science writing class and a college prep class. At the end you write a paper and give a talk.
who_can_apply: You must live in Michigan and go to a Michigan high school. You must be close enough to travel to Ann Arbor. Rising juniors and seniors are best. Most students come from partner schools: Ypsilanti Community, Lincoln and Belleville. There is no GPA minimum.
duration: 8 weeks, June 14 to Aug 6, 2027. You must be on campus at least 35 of the 40 days.
deadline_text: The BioMed Focus 2027 interest form opens Monday, Oct 12, 2026. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online interest form. One letter of recommendation is required. The page does not describe the later steps.
